Decision: Use Cloudflare Durable Objects per workspace rather than a shared D1 database. Rationale: workspace isolation by default, no sharding complexity, clean archive/delete semantics. Owner: Russell. Date: 2026-05-24. Project: Engram v0.1.

Decided in today's 1:1 with Devon: we ship Apache-2.0 as a placeholder license, subject to final confirmation at v1.0. Reason — keeps us OSS-credible without committing to AGPL terms before we understand the managed-cloud business model. Devon owns the v1.0 license review.

BMC website redesign — decision is to use Astro + Cloudflare Pages instead of Next.js + Vercel. Rationale: Cloudflare bill stays under one vendor; Astro's content collections suit the marketing copy we have. Owner: Devon. Decided 2026-04-12. Project tag: BMC-WEBSITE.

We will NOT build a web UI for Engram in v0.1. Reasoning: MCP-first is the thesis; building UI now would burn time on a second-class surface before we know the MCP surface is right. Russell decided 2026-05-23. Phase target: any post-v0.4 milestone.
On the job-search agent: keep using the existing memory backend through May; cut over to Engram for daily use after Phase 7 ships. Russell owns the cutover. Date of decision: 2026-05-20.

Decision (logged 2026-05-15, owner: Russell, project: Engram): Defer Vectorize indexing optimization (HNSW tuning, ef search params) until we have a real-world recall corpus to measure against. Premature optimization risk outweighs the latency we'd save.

Picked GPT-tokenizer over tiktoken for MCP-08's 8K-token assertions. Why: pure-JS bundles cleanly into workerd; tiktoken's WASM init cost on cold starts isn't worth the Claude-fidelity for what is a safety ceiling, not a precision metric. Decided by Russell.

Decision from today's planning session — Engram v0.1 will ship honest envelope stubs rather than templated heuristics. Reasoning: Phase 5 should POPULATE rather than RESTRUCTURE. Owner: Russell, 2026-05-26, against the Phase 4 plan.

After the architecture review, we're keeping the two-DO topology (EngramMcp session + WorkspaceDO durable). The alternative (single-DO with discriminator column) would have been simpler to scaffold but harder to evolve toward v0.3's UserDO/TeamDO/ProjectDO hierarchy. Russell owns; date 2026-05-18.
Devon and Russell agreed on a sync window. Mondays 9am PT for engagement check-ins. Owner of the cadence: Devon. No specific project; standing meeting.

Title: "Cloudflare Workers AI llama-3.1-8b structured output". Topic: Cloudflare AI / LLM JSON mode. Found at https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/json-mode/. Summary: Workers AI now supports response_format with type 'json_schema'; pass the schema in the request payload and the model conforms to it. Saves a parsing layer. Tags: cloudflare, workers-ai, llm, json-mode, structured-output.

Research on mem0 conflict resolution: their LLM-resolver maps to four ops — ADD / UPDATE / DELETE / NOOP. Source: https://docs.mem0.ai/conflict-resolution. Key takeaway: keeping conflict resolution in the LLM (not pre-computed rules) trades determinism for adaptability. Engram should consider this for v0.2 conflict detection. Tags: mem0, conflict-resolution, llm, memory.

Letta (formerly MemGPT) — self-edit memory mode. Title: Letta self-edit. URL: https://letta.com/blog/self-editing-memory. Summary: agents can call tools that rewrite their own memory blocks via patch operations. Risk: ungated self-edit becomes hallucination amplifier; Letta gates with a separate 'archival memory' tier. Engram should NOT adopt before v0.3 reflect ships. Tags: letta, memgpt, self-edit, agent-memory.

Notes on the MCP Resource Server pattern (2025-03-26 spec revision). The pattern uses /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource to advertise the Authorization Server's location. Bridge tools like mcp-remote expect this exact shape. Read at https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-03-26/oauth. Tags: mcp, oauth, resource-server, mcp-remote.

Quick read on Vectorize namespaces (Cloudflare). Title: Vectorize namespaces tenant isolation. From https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/best-practices/namespaces/. Key fact — one global index with namespace per workspace beats one-index-per-workspace because of the 100-index-per-account cap. Engram v0.1 must follow this. Tags: cloudflare, vectorize, namespaces, multi-tenant.

Working notes — bge-base-en-v1.5 embedding quality. Topic: text embeddings for retrieval. No URL handy. Summary: bge-base-en-v1.5 outputs 768-dimensional embeddings; cosine metric typical; performs well on RAG retrieval benchmarks vs. e5-base. Recommended for English-only workloads under 512 tokens. Tags: embeddings, bge, retrieval, rag.

Read this on the train — Anthropic's prompt-cache 5-minute TTL. Title: Claude API prompt cache TTL. Source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#cache-lifetime. Summary: cache TTL is 5 minutes from last read; reads refresh it; expired blocks recompute on next request. Implication for Claude Code: keep wakeup intervals under 270s to stay in cache. Tags: anthropic, claude, prompt-cache, ttl, claude-code.

@cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider README review. Title: workers-oauth-provider library. URL: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider. Summary: ships /authorize, /token, /jwks, /register, /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource endpoints out of the box. Single dependency, no external provider, fully MCP-native. Phase 3 D-02 adoption. Tags: cloudflare, oauth, mcp, workers.

Title: Durable Objects SQLite migration footgun. Topic: Cloudflare DO storage. Source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/best-practices/migrations/. Summary: Once a DO class lands under new_sqlite_classes it CANNOT be moved back to new_classes — declaration is irreversible. Confirms Engram FND-08 CI lint rule. Tags: cloudflare, durable-objects, sqlite, migrations, irreversible.

Notes from the agents SDK source dive: getAgentByName(namespace, name) returns a Promise<DurableObjectStub<T>> that MUST be awaited. Missing the await yields a Promise where the user expected a stub — subtle bug. Title: agents SDK getAgentByName pitfall. Topic: agents SDK + Durable Object stubs. No public URL — pulled from node_modules/agents/dist. Tags: agents-sdk, durable-objects, async, pitfall.
